name: Похотливый монстр
alt: Розовый рогатый монстр обнимает мешок золота и протягивает ему цветок.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment. Saturated colors, simple chunky forms, strong readable silhouette, minimal scenery, one visual joke. Large centered subject with comfortable margins. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, card frame or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: A goofy round pink furry monster with two small curved horns, exactly two arms and two short legs, one tail. Huge dreamy heart-shaped pupils and puckered lips. It hugs a bulging bag of gold with one arm, offering it a tiny daisy with the other hand, absurdly smitten with treasure. Fully nonsexual, no nudity, no human companions, simple clear five-digit mittenlike paws.
